method.motion_unit: source-image pixels per second, not km/h
method.history: same ID and same assigned zone, consecutive observed frames; bottom-center displacement over 1.0 to 1.2 s original PTS
method.window_statistic: Within each 10 s window, each ID rate is averaged using its valid motion durations; these ID averages are combined by a median weighted by valid motion durations.
method.history_reset: missing observation, zone change, invalid frame, nonconsecutive frame index, and before/after any presentation duration >0.5 s
method.availability: complete valid 10 s window, no overlap with presentation duration >0.5 s, motion vehicle-seconds / observed vehicle-seconds >=0.5, motion vehicle-seconds >=5
method.summary_statistic: Duration-weighted P25/P50/P75 of available 10 s motion medians; lower inverse-CDF weighted quantiles. All available windows are 10 s.
method.calibration: none; no P25 low-motion threshold, count-level or 30 s traffic state is newly calculated
method.caution: Compare only same ROI after reviewing acquisition/configuration comparability. Image motion is perspective-dependent; evidence selection, box jitter, occlusion and tracking fragmentation affect these values. No congestion, flow or accuracy claims.
